notes: Both waws take the *And* written for them (rule 14); *cut off* keeps its particle with the verb, headed on *cut*, since *off* completes the lexeme and is not a complement (rule 44).
`צֹרֲרֵי נַפְשִׁי` writes no relational *of* because the ASV made the rectum the object of its English relative clause, so the noun keeps only its own word (rule 19's limit), and `כָל` keeps *all*.
The final verbless clause puts *am* on `עַבְדֶּךָ` and leaves `אֲנִי` only its own *I* (rule 20). Nothing is added or unrepresented.
